name: ClubOccupancyCheckInMonitor
tagline: Live club and zone occupancy, peak-hours heat map and a front-desk exception queue – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete front-desk and duty-manager app for health clubs: live occupancy against safe capacity per club and zone, a weekday × hour heat map from four weeks of check-ins, a searchable visit log with bulk check-out, an access-exception desk with override rules and approvers, and a guest-pass register with host allowances and convert-to-lead. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Capacity gauges per club with Comfortable / Busy / At capacity levels
Today vs typical weekday check-ins and occupancy curve
Heat map of check-ins, occupancy or exceptions with drill-down
Exception desk: grant override (approver, blocked at capacity), deny, resolve
Frozen memberships overridable by duty managers only
No check-out, off-peak at peak and guest-allowance flags
Bulk check-out with undo, CSV export, filters, grouping
Guest passes with host allowance and convert to lead
Phone layout with bottom navigation, tested at 375/360/320 px
